location.title: Location
location.hint: Type a city name, such as Edinburgh or Madrid. Add a country after a comma to narrow it down.

viewing.minElevationHint: Hide passes that never climb above this height.

sync.title: Sync

demo.body: Replaying {{date}} in London from {{time}}, with the orbit data bundled in the app.
